_comment: The records CreArtBox has made, read by tools/build_discography.py and
by tools/build_seo.py. Edit this, never discography.html.
Every field here is taken from the Tracklist.txt that sits beside the
masters in Bunny, or off the cover itself. Nothing is invented: if a
player is not named on the tracklist, the player is not named here.
audioBase is where the mp3s live. A record whose audio has not been
uploaded yet sets "audio": false and its tracks print without a play
button, which is better than twenty-three buttons that 404.

prices.note: Every copy is signed, with a personal note from the artists. Shipping is charged on top and depends on where you are.
